within_contact_window.note: Share of RECORDED first responses within 72 calendar hours. Cases with no first response are censored and excluded, so this share says nothing about them.

call_center.note: First-contact handle time across all contact reasons. Not dispute-specific: there is no join key from complaints to interactions.

resolution_before_first_response.note: Over complaints that have both a first response and a resolution date.

claimed_amount_by_currency.note: Medians per currency, never summed across currencies. Medians of similar size in currencies with very different FX rates are not consistent with real amounts in those currencies.

complaint_interaction_link.note: Share of complaints with origin_interaction_id populated.

eval.disclosure: OFFLINE/SIMULATED: the Anthropic client is mocked deterministically for reproducibility. Measures the state machine's policy pipeline and processing latency, NOT real LLM quality, network latency, or real API cost.

real_data_match.note: Quoted from the eval snapshot, not recomputed here. Measured on this synthetic dataset, which generates complaints and transactions independently; it says nothing about a real bank's match rate.

agent_pipeline_p50_seconds.note: Offline eval pipeline time with a mocked LLM; excludes network time.

human_first_contact_handle_time.note: First-contact handle time across all contact reasons. Not dispute-specific: there is no join key from complaints to interactions.

agent_llm_cost_usd.method: estimated from constructed prompt/response character counts (~4 chars/token), not measured API billing
agent_llm_cost_usd.pricing_source: https://www.anthropic.com/claude/haiku (Haiku 4.5, $1/$5 per M input/output tokens, verified 2026-09-28)
agent_llm_cost_usd.disclosure: OFFLINE/SIMULATED: the Anthropic client is mocked deterministically for reproducibility. Measures the state machine's policy pipeline and processing latency, NOT real LLM quality, network latency, or real API cost.

projection.formula: expected human handle cost per case (USD) = (1 - automation share) x anchor handle hours x hourly rate

automation_shares.label: baseline
automation_shares.note: Baseline: 1 amount and date match in a sample of 2,000 dataset complaints (eval snapshot). The dataset generates complaints and transactions independently, so it gives no basis for any share above 0.

automation_shares.label: scenario-suite outcome, not a population estimate
automation_shares.note: 6 of 29 constructed eval scenarios ended in a safe automated resolution.

projection.prerequisite: Real complaint-to-transaction linkage or a redesigned intake is required before any automation share can be claimed.
